firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Pre-registration for a confirmatory experiment in my Paper Track entry, "Can a small local agent redo a cloud agent's work?"

Question: does more context help Gemma 4 E4B on real changes? 93 tasks from an agent-built health-data repository, each run by the competition's harness (swegemma; same agent, settings and order) in three arms:
1. as published;
2. with graph retrieval done for the agent, built from the statement and the code graph alone;
3. with the failing test's report. This comes from the hidden test, so it is a test-first workflow's context, not a benchmark condition.

Outcome: resolved, by the competition's own verify_task. Test: exact McNemar, two-sided, each arm against "as published". A claim needs p < 0.05.

Plan, SHA-256: 1b517ae1bb96d84d670ac6891542278275a0802a33ac57dae43c0c715e43d7c4
Addendum 1 (graph arm, core split), SHA-256: 7121f14cd2c28baaa63af5bbcc35d668edb1fe8843f0351005673819393a0f29

Both hashes were recorded on GitHub before the results they cover existed: the plan at 14:39 UTC on November 11, before the first kernel started; the addendum at 14:56 UTC, while the first two arms were still running and before any outcome was read. This post came later and mirrors them.

Public record, with the plan files and how to check each hash:
https://github.com/healthtransformationlab/health-transformation-lab-nlp/issues/674
